palette: patina-bronze ground + engraved copper plates + pale chiseled inscriptions + oxide-green seals + warm brass ordinals + dark engraving ink
typography: chiseled pale inscriptions on copper plates, dark atelier label tabs with brass left bar, oxide-green stamps reserved for delegation verdicts, brass ordinal marks, thin pale underline for tests
composition: the four subjects stand as an engraved plate row with year stamps; the creation procedure runs as a four-step engraving line from drafting to promulgation; the delegation scene pairs the people with their commission beside a power-boundary plate
surface: flat patina-bronze ground with faint engraving-rule hairlines, copper plates with hairline weathered borders and corner rivets, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: inscriptions carve onto the plates stroke by stroke, year stamps land once and hold, the procedure line draws step by step, the commission link ties the two plates together
transition: a burnishing pass sweeps the frame and the atelier clears for the next plate
